rule.statement: The burden of proof rests squarely on a party invoking the Prescription Ordinance to establish a starting point for acquiring prescriptive rights.
rule.supporting_quote: Where a party invokes the provisions of section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance in order to defeat the ownership of an adverse claimant to immovable property, the burden of proof rests squarely and fairly on him to establish a starting point for his or her acquisition of prescriptive rights.
